lead: Check every spelling against `php -r` before deciding a family is refused, because PHP does not always agree with itself.
body: `echo $a[];` and `unset($a[])` are compile errors, but `$a[] .= "x"` appends silently even at `error_reporting=-1`, so refusing the third is a divergence that needs its own row under `rule:php-migration/every-divergence-is-deliberate-and-listed`, not a doc-comment sentence. A probe under `.agent-tmp/` run through both `nvs run` and `php` settles a paragraph before it is written.
